paper_metadata.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
paper_metadata.abstract: We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering. Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor, GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity. To advance model alignment and autonomy, we implement a new asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure that drastically improves post-training efficiency by decoupling generation from training. Furthermore, we propose novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms that further improve RL quality, enabling the model to learn from complex, long-horizon interactions more effectively. Through these innovations, GLM-5 achieves state-of-the-art performance on major open benchmarks. Most critically, GLM-5 demonstrates unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges. Code, models, and more information are available at https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-5.

extraction_data.innovation: Dynamic Sparse Attention (DSA): reduces training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity; Asynchronous RL infrastructure: decouples generation from training to drastically improve post-training efficiency; Novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms: enables effective learning from complex, long-horizon interactions; On-Policy Cross-Stage Distillation: prevents catastrophic forgetting across sequential RL stages.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 27 trillion token corpus prioritizing code and reasoning
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Sequential Reinforcement Learning (Reasoning RL, Agentic RL, General RL)
extraction_data.extension: DSA dynamically allocates attention resources based on token importance; MTP shares parameters across 3 draft layers to increase acceptance rate while keeping memory cost constant.
extraction_data.research_problem: Transitioning from vibe coding to agentic engineering; addressing computational cost and real-world adaptability bottlenecks in complex software engineering.
extraction_data.application: End-to-end software engineering, agentic tasks, long-horizon planning, reasoning, coding
extraction_data.paper_title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
extraction_data.hardware_description: Single Chinese node (NPU); performance comparable to dual-GPU international clusters
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Dynamic Sparse Attention (DSA), DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), Multi-latent Attention (MLA), Sparse attention, Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training (27T tokens) -> Mid-training (context extension 4K to 200K) -> Sequential Post-Training (Reasoning RL -> Agentic RL -> General RL) with On-Policy Cross-Stage Distillation
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: Interleaved thinking between tool calls; preserved thinking
extraction_data.quantization_precision: INT4, W4A8 mixed-precision (W8A8 for Attention/MLP, W4A8 for MoE experts)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Interleaved packing of highly similar texts; MRCR-like data variants for multi-turn dialogues
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Asynchronous agent RL, Asynchronous Agent RL (Reasoning RL, Agentic RL, General RL), Policy gradient
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Group-normalized advantage; on-policy cross-stage distillation for refinement, Outcome supervision, iterative self-distillation, Multi-level reward design (Level-1: structural validity, Level-2: runtime rendering properties like width/height/bounding boxes, Level-3: visual perceptual features like whitespace patterns)
extraction_data.training_environment_scale: Simulated environments (e.g., year-long simulated vending machine business)
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: Zero-redundant communication for Muon distributed optimizer
